description: This file defines a class `JsonValueFieldDefinition` which extends `AbstractJsonFieldDefinition`. It provides methods for creating type-safe JSON field definitions, including a factory method for instantiation and an override for converting JSON values to Java types using provided functions.

classes.name: JsonValueFieldDefinition
classes.description: A final class for type-safe JSON field definitions that extends `AbstractJsonFieldDefinition`. Provides factory method `newInstance` and overrides `getAsJavaType` for converting JSON values.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method for creating a new instance of `JsonValueFieldDefinition` with specified pointer, value type, check function, mapping function, and optional markers.

methods.name: getAsJavaType
methods.description: Overrides a method to convert a given `JsonValue` to a Java type using the provided `mappingFunction`.
